title: Characterizing Oblivious Common-Reward Multi-Player Bandits: Universal Stationarity, Coordination Traps, and Certified Global Rates
abstract: arXiv:2610.29673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the oblivious common-reward multi-player multi-armed bandit (OC-MPMAB), a minimal multi-player bandit model in which multiple players select arms simultaneously and observe only a shared reward. Crucially, the players are fully oblivious: they do not observe the actions of other players and do not even know whether any other players exist. The contributions of this work are threefold. First, we prove that the independent gradient-bandit updates applied by the players jointly form an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator of a hidden product-policy objective. This property then yields a universal finite-time first-order stationarity guarantee for every instance. Second, we show that stationarity cannot, in general, be strengthened to global optimality. tldr: 本文证明在无感知共同奖励多玩家多臂老虎机中，玩家独立的梯度更新共同构成隐藏乘积策略目标的无偏随机梯度估计，从而获得适用于所有实例的通用有限时间一阶平稳性保证，同时通过乘积策略陷阱障碍表明平稳性一般无法提升为全局最优性。
